notes: Account background: Legal-tech SaaS focused on pan-European discovery & contract search for in-house legal teams. Strong need for high-precision answers in 10+ languages (EN, FR, DE, ES, NL, IT, PL, PT, SV, DA).

Primary ask: Replace current Elastic-based vector overlay with production RAG stack that maintains per-language recall/precision targets and keeps 95th pct query latency <150ms for short queries (avg doc snippet retrieval + rerank).
Scale requirements: ~800M indexed passages across legal docs + precedents; expected peak QPS 400-600 on weekday business hours; nightly bulk ingest + continuous deltas.

Cost sensitivity: Needs guidance on cost-per-query target. Internal goal: average infra cost <$0.0015/query for embeddings+rerank at scale. Looking for batching, quantization & routing levers from Redwood Optimize to get there.

Model preferences: prefer open multilingual encoder models for embeddings (50-100 dims quantized), candidate reranker can be instruction-tuned multilingual cross-encoder. Want variant routing (fast/cheap multilingual vs high-precision per-language models).

Security/Compliance: Cannot send EU customer documents to third-country control plane. Must support customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention 7 years, SSO + SCIM for provisioning. Will evaluate Redwood Private (VPC) or on-prem package.
